title: Towards Efficient Pareto Set Approximation via Mixture of Experts Based Model Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2406.09770v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Solving multi-objective optimization problems for large deep neural networks is a challenging task due to the complexity of the loss landscape and the expensive computational cost of training and evaluating models. Efficient Pareto front approximation of large models enables multi-objective optimization for various tasks such as multi-task learning and trade-off analysis. Existing algorithms for learning Pareto set, including (1) evolutionary, hypernetworks, and hypervolume-maximization methods, are computationally expensive and have restricted scalability to large models; (2) Scalarization algorithms, where a separate model is trained for each objective ray, which is inefficient for learning the entire Pareto set and fails to capture the objective trade-offs effectively. Inspired by the recent success of model merging, we propose a practical and scalable approach to Pareto set learning problem via mixture of experts (MoE) base

translated_title: 基于专家混合模型融合的高效帕累托集逼近方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2406.09770v2 公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：对于大型深度神经网络，求解多目标优化问题是一项具有挑战性的任务，这源于损失景观的复杂性以及训练和评估模型的高昂计算成本。高效逼近大型模型的帕累托前沿，能够支持多任务学习和权衡分析等多种应用中的多目标优化。现有的帕累托集学习算法，包括（1）进化算法、超网络和超体积最大化方法，计算成本高，且难以扩展到大型模型；（2）标量化算法，即为每个目标方向训练独立模型，这在学习整个帕累托集时效率低下，且无法有效捕捉目标间的权衡。受近期模型合并成功的启发，我们提出了一种基于专家混合（MoE）的实用且可扩展的帕累托集学习方法。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于专家混合模型融合的帕累托集逼近方法，显著提高了大规模深度神经网络多目标优化的效率与可扩展性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Pareto set approximation method based on mixture of experts model fusion, significantly improving the efficiency and scalability of multi-objective optimization for large deep neural networks.
